tools.name: get_refund_checklist
tools.description: Choose the service-export refund stage and preparation topic to retrieve records, checks, next steps and relevant guides.

tools.name: search_refund_guides
tools.description: Find public guidance by preparation topic. Use general keywords only, without taxpayer identifiers or document contents.

tools.name: read_refund_guide
tools.description: Retrieve a public guide using a slug from search_refund_guides. Returns Markdown with source links and the recorded source-check date.

tools.name: explain_upload_error
tools.description: Get documented checks and correction steps. Statement 3 issues: json_generation, receipt_allocation, corrected_retry, return_mismatch. Annexure B: duplicate_document, gstr2b_mismatch, reversals, json_generation.

tools.name: check_receipt_allocation
tools.description: Check arithmetic, duplicate allocations, missing row references, overallocated receipts and invoice balances. Send anonymous row numbers and integer INR paise; keep names, GSTINs and certificate numbers local. Up to 200 invoices, 200 receipts and 1000 allocations.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: explain_upload_error · Private data: get_refund_checklist, search_refund_guides · Public sink: explain_upload_error, check_receipt_allocation.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: explain_upload_error · Private data: get_refund_checklist, search_refund_guides · Public sink: explain_upload_error, check_receipt_allocation

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
